cohort: The study included 43,876 pregnancies from three tertiary care Australian hospitals over a 36-month period.
finding: Treated intrahepatic cholestasis of pregnancy was associated with lower gestational age at delivery, lower birth weight, and increased special care nursery admissions, while having similar mortality outcomes compared to non-intrahepatic cholestasis of pregnancy pregnancies.
birth_weight: Median birth weight was 3.12 kg for ICP pregnancies and 3.31 kg for non-ICP pregnancies.
gest_age: Median gestational age at delivery was 36.4 weeks for ICP pregnancies and 38.6 weeks for non-ICP pregnancies.
